keys.effect: Horizontal rendering and display resolution in pixels.
keys.notes: May default to DPI-scaled resolution (e.g. 4096 on 5120x1440 with 125% Windows scaling). Always match native display resolution.

keys.effect: Vertical rendering and display resolution in pixels.
Enables aggressive low-spec engine optimizations and lower fidelity asset fallbacks.
keys.notes: Often incorrectly flagged as True on initial game boot on modern hardware.

keys.effect: Intensity multiplier for camera shake during impacts and explosions.
keys.notes: Set to 0.000000 under motion_comfort modifier to reduce eye strain.

keys.effect: Maximum frame rate limit in FPS (0 = uncapped).
keys.notes: On VRR displays, cap 3 FPS below max refresh rate to keep G-Sync/FreeSync active without engaging VSync lag.

keys.effect: Internal game engine frame rate cap toggle (locks to 60 FPS when True).
keys.notes: Must be set to False to unlock high refresh rates above 60 FPS and allow FrameRateLimit to take effect.

keys.effect: First launch flag triggering initial setup wizard and automatic hardware benchmarking.
keys.notes: Setting to False prevents the game from rerunning auto-detection and overwriting custom resolution and quality settings on launch.

keys.effect: Enables native High Dynamic Range (HDR) display output.
keys.notes: Enable if using an HDR-capable monitor (pair with HDRDisplayOutputNits matching display peak luminance).

keys.effect: Ray-traced directional and local light shadows.
keys.notes: Severe performance penalty at ultrawide resolutions (30%+ FPS loss) with subtle visual impact over rasterized shadows.

keys.effect: Ray-traced ambient occlusion.
keys.notes: Very heavy compute overhead. SSAO Quality 3 provides clean contact shadowing with far better frametime stability.

keys.effect: Ray-traced reflections on wet streets, puddle surfaces, and metallic surfaces.
keys.notes: Core aesthetic feature for cyberpunk visual style. Viable at 60+ FPS when paired with DLSS on high-end hardware.

keys.effect: NVIDIA Deep Learning Super Sampling upscaling.
DLSS profile preset (3 = Quality, 4 = Balanced, 5 = Performance).
Chromatic aberration / color fringing post-processing effect.
keys.notes: Disabling removes peripheral color blurring, improving image clarity and reducing eye strain.

keys.effect: Depth of field background blur quality.
keys.notes: Disabling keeps all background planes in focus, preventing focal fatigue in an isometric camera.

keys.effect: Film grain quantization overlay.
Engine-level motion blur quality (0 = off).
Screen edge vignette shading.
Texture streaming pool size in MB.
keys.notes: Set to 4000 for 12GB+ GPUs to eliminate texture popping.

keys.effect: Forces all in-use textures to stream to full resolution and lock in VRAM.
keys.notes: Eliminates texture pop-in and streaming hitches during combat. Safe on 12GB+ GPUs (adds ~1.5-2GB VRAM usage).

keys.effect: Hierarchical Level of Detail streaming strategy (2 = disable streaming, load all HLODs).
keys.notes: Keeps distant city geometry and skyline meshes fully loaded in VRAM, eliminating traversal hitches across arcology vistas.

keys.effect: Field of view axis lock (AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV forces Hor+ scaling).
keys.notes: Prevents vertical cropping (Vert-) on ultrawide (21:9) and super-ultrawide (32:9) monitors.

engine_overrides.behaviour: Default camera boom applies Vert- cropping at 21:9 and 32:9 aspect ratios.
engine_overrides.action: Set AspectRatioAxisConstraint=AspectRatio_MaintainYFOV under [/Script/Engine.LocalPlayer] in Engine.ini. For additional camera zoom out, use Rose's Ultrawide and Superwide Fix & FOV Changer.

engine_overrides.behaviour: In-game HUD widgets are anchored directly to viewport canvas corners without UMG SafeZone wrappers, ignoring r.DebugSafeZone margins.
engine_overrides.action: Do not set r.DebugSafeZone.TitleRatio in Engine.ini; it has no effect on in-game gameplay HUD elements and only undesirably displaces the loading screen progress bar.

manual_only_settings.location: External Mod: The Ascent Ultrawide and Superwide Fix & FOV Changer (PCGamingWiki File #2250)
manual_only_settings.recommendation: Use F3 / F4 to zoom out the camera distance beyond default limits.
manual_only_settings.reason: The game's blueprint camera boom clamps camera distance and does not expose a vanilla zoom-out slider.

notes: On high-DPI displays with Windows scaling active (125%+), The Ascent can default to non-native resolution (e.g. 4096x1152 instead of 5120x1440). Verify ResolutionSizeX and ResolutionSizeY match native display bounds.

Ray Tracing Shadows and Ray Tracing Ambient Occlusion introduce heavy frametime penalties at 5120x1440. Disabling them while keeping Ray Tracing Reflections maintains visual punch and solid 60+ FPS stability on RTX 4070 SUPER.
